## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-juan preface-only text preserving a Northern-Sòng *yǔlù*-preface, X69 n1339. Non-commentary; *commentedTextid* omitted.

[Lángyá Huìjué](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E8%A6%BA) 瑯琊慧覺: Northern-Sòng Línjì-lineage master. Lifedates unrecorded; dharma-heir of [Fényáng Shànzhāo](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E6%98%AD) 汾陽善昭 (947–1024). One of the second-generation Línjì masters active between Shànzhāo and Shíshuāng Chǔyuán.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1050 (Huìjué's mature teaching-years); *notAfter* c. 1100.
